name: mcp-apps-playground-auth0-extension
description: Auth0 Custom Extension hosting the MCP Gateway Playground travel and Auth0 Forms tools.
author: atko-scratch

scripts.host: cd ../mcp-ext-apps/examples/basic-host && npm install --silent && SERVERS='["http://localhost:3001/mcp"]' npm run start
scripts.build:extension: rimraf dist build/bundle.js && node scripts/validate-manifest.mjs && esbuild src/webtask.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --loader:.html=text --external:edge --external:superagent-proxy --outfile=dist/extension.js && mkdir -p build && cp dist/extension.js build/bundle.js && node scripts/create-extension-package.mjs && zip -j -q dist/package.zip dist/extension.js dist/package.json
scripts.build: npm run build:apps && npm run build:extension
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke

auth0.scopes: read:resource_servers create:resource_servers read:connections update:connections read:tenant_settings update:tenant_settings create:client_grants read:client_grants

SESSION_SECRET.description: At least 32 characters. Signs the short-lived context JWT used by the Auth0 Forms tools.

AUTH0_FORMS_PROFILE_FORM_ID.description: ID of the Auth0 Form used by the Update profile tool in this tenant, for example ap_abc123.

AUTH0_FORMS_PAYMENT_FORM_ID.description: ID of the Auth0 Form used by the Update payment details tool in this tenant, for example ap_abc123.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Optional external public MCP origin override, for example https://mcp.example.com. Leave empty for the installed Webtask URL.
